answer: The proof is checked where it was made; the applicant's story about the place counts for nothing. One threshold for every key: Hemmer wool jacket mark sewn into the pressing bench, and one receipt, each wool jacket is a season of logged stitching plus a signed master-tailor record, no matter whose hand carries it. Where did the harbor come from? Who painted the anchor? When was the mirror finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. Proof sells at 92 POA a piece; the farm's 818 pieces lock 75256 POA away, gone for good if it cheats.
